title: FOIA request for USAF Campinas flight records answered by the CIA
summary: James Fox tells of FOIA request for USAF Campinas flight records answered by the CIA, about 1996; FOIA 2022 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: our team we filed a foyer and uh in in 2022, I think it was.

plain: UFO researcher James Fox says his team used the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone request government records, to ask the US Air Force for flight records linked to events in 1996 around Campinas, a city in Brazil. He says they filed it around 2022, and that the answer came back not from the Air Force but from the CIA, the US spy agency, which he takes as a sign the matter interested the intelligence world.
